newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks end lower, mood uncertain.
newsitem.headline: French stocks end lower, mood uncertain.

text.p: French equities closed with slim losses, with modest proft-taking taking the steam out the market's partial rebound since Friday's fall on Greenspan's warning to the markets.
Traders said investors were hesitant ahead of Thursday's television appearance by President Jacques Chirac and Wednesday's release of U.S. PPI figures.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down 4.44 points or 0.2 percent at 2,251.40 while the CAC-40 futures contract was down at 2,257 from 2,260 on Monday's close.
* Only a week ago, Paris was hitting fresh year-highs, and gaining one percent in successive sessions, with buoyant hopes for a year-end close around the 2,360.98 historic high.
* A British broker in Paris said although institutional investors had not sold off, Greenspan enjoyed widespread credibility and the markets would likely move more cautiously.
* Chirac may reveal a cabinet reshuffle, but the strong franc policy would likely stay, holding little to seduce equities which want a devaluation, said one analyst.
* The state expects to announce new terms of the Thomson privatisation soon, spokesman Alain Lamassoure said.
* Weakness in U.S. and French bonds helped trigger the modest round of profit-taking.
* Alcatel Alsthom closes down 3.41 percent at 433.5 francs, dragged by poor outlook for CIT subsidiary.
* Total, another CAC index heavyweight, eased 1.80 percent to 402.6 francs, dented by strikes at refineries.
* Canal Plus sheds 1.44 percent to 1,167 francs, on the back of a negative article on its Spanish subsidiary.
* Pechiney adds 3.4 percent to 210.4, helped by news of European and U.S. asset sales.
* The European chip maker has benefited from a rise in New York on the back of its entry into a Morgan Stanley high-tech index.
* Roussel-Uclaf ends up 2.79 percent at 1,439 francs, tracks gains on parent Hoechst, on news of consolidation moves with Clariant.
* A merger-type deal is to be announced on Wednesday 0800 GMT in the chemicals/pharmaceuticals sector involving a French company, a public relations official said after the close.
